effects.tooltip: Epic Vulkoor's Cunning : 2 Pieces Equipped: -20% Artifact bonus to Melee Threat Reduction +10 Artifact bonus to Melee and Ranged Power You gain On Vorpal: You apply a Vulkoorim Constitution Poison
